_comment: Rules for the shared privacy scanner (amajail/dev-kit). The engine is shared;
these rules are not, because what counts as private differs per repo.
This repo holds AFIP tax credentials and real invoicing data, and it is PUBLIC.
Deliberately no real CUIT, cert name or invoice number appears below — the
patterns describe the SHAPE of private data, never an instance of it.
privatePaths: an AFIP certificate or private key
a runtime log, which records real invoice traffic

privatePaths.what: possibly a real invoice or exchange export

_privatePathExceptionsWhy: All three are denied by the BUILT-IN `.env` rule, and a rule's own `unless`
cannot reach a default — hence this list rather than an `unless`. `.env.example`
and `dashboard/.env.example` are the committed templates listing which variables
to set, values elided; `dashboard/.env.production` is the public dashboard's
build-time API URL, un-ignored in .gitignore for that reason. Anchored to those
exact names, so a real `.env`, `.env.local` or root `.env.production` stay denied.
_selfExemptWhy: This file necessarily contains the patterns it looks for, and a shaped-but-fake CUIT as the placeholder example. Exempt from CONTENT rules only — never from path rules.

wording.boundary: AFIP certificates, private keys and real invoice data
wording.confirm: a real CUIT, certificate, or invoice figure
wording.fixHint:
Real certificates belong in certificates/ (gitignored), never in the repo.
  If this rule is wrong, fix it in .privacy-scan.json — do not work around it.
